_meta.standard: DPS 2022 — Saudi Electricity Company Distribution Planning Standard
_meta.note: Values used by the real Y-Tower EL-CAL-5002 load calculation. Indicative — an engineer confirms per project. FLAG: DPS 2022 is a Saudi standard but the project is in Egypt; confirm applicable code with the design office.

power_density_va_per_m2._note: Only C6 (coffee shop) and C7 (offices) appear in the real report; other categories referenced but not enumerated there.

load_table_current_divisor._source: EL-CAL-5002 LV-01 table header: Demand Load*1000/(3*230)
load_table_current_divisor._note: The load table divides by 3*230=690 (drives breaker choice). The prose on p.6 says 3*220=660 — a source typo; the table and printed values use 690.
